description: Returns the public deep link https://9code.app/code/{code} for an owned address as {ok, code, url, shareText}. Use it when the user wants a shareable URL; it does not modify the address. Fails if the code is invalid or not owned by the connected account.

code.description: Anwani permanent 9-digit address code (digits 1–9 only). Example: 365131449

name: share_address
